title: ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
body:
Ran me aakar sakina pukaaari, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
bane qasim behen tum pa waari, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi shaadi qayaamat ye aayi, hui doolha dulhan me judaai
nek apna mai lene na paayi, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai kya jald ghar se sidhaare, rasm poore hue na hamaare
muntazar hai baraati tumhaare, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
joda shaadi ka tan me naya hai, sou'wo zaqmo'n se purze hua hai
khoon sab dasto paa me laga hai, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Bar me shaadi ki rangee'n qaba hai, sar pa phoolo'n ka sehra bandha hai
chaand sa muh lahu me bhara hai, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali masnad padi hai jo ghar me, qaak dulhan ne daali hai sar me
shor maatam ka hai behrobar me, ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoo'n
